title: 개인정보 단체소송규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:11:0:00011:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 11 (Resignation of Counsel, etc.)
(1) Where all counsel for the plaintiff die, resign, or are dismissed, the litigation proceedings shall be suspended until the plaintiff appoints new counsel.
(2) Where the litigation proceedings have been suspended under paragraph (1), the court shall order the plaintiff to appoint an attorney-at-law within a specified period of at least one month.
(3) Where the plaintiff fails to appoint an attorney-at-law within the specified period despite an order under paragraph (2), the court shall dismiss the action by decision.
(4) An immediate appeal may be filed against a decision under paragraph (3).
